detail.longDescription:
Well, #docker is now untrustworthy.

https://www.docker.com/blog/meet-the-new-docker-built-to-run-on-trust/

It's my fault, really, for having recently built a whole homelab on docker compose. Sorry folks, I forgot that when I love a technology it suddenly gets enshittened.

What's the move then? Generic LXC containers? Start the countdown on that suddenly going to shit somehow?

Side note, but this really gives me the ick:

We cannot simply continue to do what we’ve always done and expect to succeed in this new era.

Why? Why can't you keep doing the thing that made you incredibly popular? That powers a whole industry? What exactly is wrong with that?
